description: This file defines the KidsScreen widget, which is a stateless widget that builds the UI for the kids' screen in a Flutter application. It imports Flutter material components and a custom component called BuyFullKit, and displays an image of the kids' screen.

classes.name: KidsScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that represents the kids screen, rendering a full UI kit with a specific image.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Overrides the build method to return a BuyFullKit widget displaying an image for the kids screen.
